provenance.notes: GUI worker, real XTest pointer/keys with relative increments (one in flight); per-increment values read by a debugger hook at the tool-attribute write and at the transform-handle compute site (no editor call while a button is held), cross-checked against the editor's command journal; root-window frames; state read through the editor bridge only before arming and after release

value_drag.gesture: LMB press in empty viewport space with the tool armed, then relative increments; x = screen right

merge_points.rig: cube half-size 0.5, the 4 top vertices selected, top orthographic view
merge_points.law: value = value_at_press + 0.05 * pixel_size * (screen-x offset from the press); the written value is SIGNED during the drag (goes below 0); the value kept after release is max(0, last); a vertical drag leaves the value unchanged

inset.rig: cube half-size 0.5, the top polygon selected, top orthographic view
inset.law: value = value_at_press + c * (screen-x offset from the press), c a round step proportional to the pixel size (0.0005 m/px at pixel size 0.0021960, 0.001 at 0.0043920); SIGNED (no clamp at 0, kept negative after release); DETENTS: the value holds for 40 px of travel at 0 and at every 100 px-worth multiple (0.05 m at the first zoom, 0.1 m at the second) before continuing

round_step.rig: cube half-size 0.5, top polygon selected, front orthographic view, pixel size set per cell, press on empty space, 1 px increments to the right
round_step.law: per pixel of horizontal travel the value is snapped to the step grid and moved one step: value = (round(value / step) + dir) * step; step = the smallest of {1, 2, 5} x 10^k that is >= 0.2 * pixel_size; detent spacing = the member of {1, 2, 5} x 10^k nearest to 20 * pixel_size in log10; when a pixel step lands EXACTLY (double equality) on a detent multiple the next 36 pixels in the same direction are ignored (a direction change clears the hold); the hold width is zoom-independent

rivals.accumulate_with_clamp: refuted: merge requests go negative mid-drag; inset after the final +5 stays at the press-relative value
rivals.last_step_only: refuted: the value grows linearly with k on every leg

rig.v: quad strip in XZ, x lines 0..5, z 0..1; vertices (0,0,0),(1,0,0),(5,0,0) selected (box centre x 2.5, mean 2.0)
rig.e: same strip; the three z-edges at x = 0, 1, 5 selected
rig.p: strip x lines -0.5..5.5; the quads centred at x = 0, 1, 5 selected (box 2.5, unique-vertex mean 2.3, polygon-centre mean 2.0)
rig.v-off: as v, but the second press lands on empty space (off every handle)

selection_centre_move.tool: move, action centre = selection (centre mode 'center' = bounding-box centre, the reference help's own words), no falloff, no symmetry, top orthographic
selection_centre_move.gesture: press the arm of the first in-plane axis, 10 x 4 px right, release; press the other in-plane arm (or empty space for v-off), 5 x 4 px up, release
selection_centre_move.law: centre = bounding-box centre of the selection's vertices, computed at the session's start and FROZEN for the whole run (both drags); handle = centre + M*T at every increment with residual 0; slope exactly 1, no first-step offset. A press on an arm continues the run (T accumulates, centre unchanged); a press off every handle restarts it: T := 0 and the centre is recomputed from the MOVED selection (= old centre + M*T), so the drawn handle does not move at the press either

rivals.bbox_centre: selected in v, e, p (margin 0.5 against the vertex mean, 0.2 against the unique-vertex mean in p)

element_move_range.rig: 4x4 quad grid in XZ, spacing 0.5, facing +Y, top orthographic; the two picked vertices selected; re-arm selection = 7 boundary vertices (box 2.0 x 0.5)
element_move_range.law: a typed Range survives both hauls, a drop of the tool (switch to another tool, or Escape) and a re-arm with a different selection: it is NOT re-fitted to the selection and NOT reset to the arm-time value
element_move_range.side_observation: with a selection present only selected vertices move; an element pick on an interior vertex of back-facing polygons silently misses

channel_drag_live.rig: cube half-size 0.05, item mode, mesh item selected, no tool, top orthographic
channel_drag_live.channel_list_value_cell_lmb_drag: absent: no value change, no command (5 x 20 px)
channel_drag_live.law: the viewport follows every channel write while the button is still held (one channel write per increment, the drawn cube moves by the same step in the frame taken right after it); release changes nothing further

rivals.absent: refuted for the properties field; TRUE for an LMB drag on the channel-list value cell
